user.title: Install Hauswacht
user.description:
Hauswacht will now be created. Afterwards, everything is set up on the **settings page** – in the sidebar under “Hauswacht” or here: [open the settings page]({url}).

Tip for getting started: the docs page “How Hauswacht decides” (tab “Documentation” on the settings page).

init.title: Hauswacht
init.description: You find all settings on the settings page: [open the settings page]({url}).

abort.use_settings_page:
You find all settings of Hauswacht on the **settings page** – in the sidebar under “Hauswacht” or here: [open the settings page]({url}).

The former settings dialog was removed in version 0.63.2; the page can do everything it could.

arm.name: Arm profile
arm.description: Arms a Hauswacht profile, optionally confirming open or unavailable sensors.

profile.name: Profile
profile.description: Name or ID of the profile.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Arm even if sensors are open or unavailable (if the profile allows it). Open sensors are bypassed.

code.name: PIN code
code.description: Required if a PIN is needed for arming.

simulate_trigger.name: Simulate sensor
simulate_trigger.description: Simulates the triggering of a configured sensor. Only possible in test mode; no device is switched.

sensor.name: Sensor
sensor.description: Configured sensor whose triggering is simulated.

simulate_state.name: Simulate sensor state
simulate_state.description: Makes Hauswacht see a sensor state (open/triggered, closed/idle, unavailable) or resets it to the real value. Test mode only; the device and its state in Home Assistant stay unchanged.

simulate_reset.name: Reset simulation
simulate_reset.description: All simulated sensors back to their real state.

siren_test.name: Siren test
siren_test.description: Sounds ONE siren briefly (real sound, at most 10 s). Only disarmed, with hardware enabled, not in test mode, never during fire; administrators only.

siren_test_result.name: Siren test: result
siren_test_result.description: Stores whether the siren was heard.

reset_code_lock.name: Reset failed attempts
reset_code_lock.description: Resets the counter of wrong PIN/card entries and a running PIN lock. Administrators only.

guest_mode.name: Guest mode
guest_mode.description: Switch the guest mode on or off: while it is on, Hauswacht does not arm the area automatically (neither by time nor when everyone is away). Arming by hand still works. Target “All areas” = all.

until.name: Until
until.description: Ends automatically at this time. Empty = until switched off.

keypad_input.name: Keypad input
keypad_input.description: Reports button and PIN/card of a generic keypad (ZHA, Z-Wave, ESPHome …) to Hauswacht. Returns the result. Only for automations, scripts and administrators.

keypad.name: Keypad
keypad.description: ID or name of the keypad in Hauswacht – or its display entity.

button.name: Button
button.description: disarm, emergency or one of the keypad's own buttons (e.g. away).

code.name: PIN or card
code.description: Typed PIN or card number read.

force.name: Arm anyway
force.description: Bypass open sensors if the profile and the user allow it.

passage.name: Passage
passage.description: Open a passage without disarming: while the entry delay is running, the person is let in (the opened door is free until it is closed); otherwise the first entry door that opens is free for the passage time. Only if the armed profile allows passage.

code.name: PIN
code.description: PIN or card (needed if PINs are set up).

simulate_presence.name: Simulate presence
simulate_presence.description: Makes Hauswacht believe a person's presence (home, away with or without proof, approaching) or resets it to the real signals. Test mode only; the person in Home Assistant and the homecoming observation stay unchanged.

person.name: Person
person.description: A person from “arm when all away” or “On return”.

skip_wait.name: Skip waiting time
skip_wait.description: Ends a running “arm when all away” waiting time at once (test mode only).

users_without_pin.title: Hauswacht: not every user has a PIN
users_without_pin.description:
As soon as a PIN exists, the panel (and Alexa) require it **from everyone** to disarm. These Hauswacht users have no PIN and cannot disarm there: **{people}**.

Options:
- Give them a PIN on the settings page (sidebar “Hauswacht”) in the tab “People and control devices” (a shared family PIN is allowed), or
- enable “Allow dashboard buttons despite PIN” on the settings page in the tab “People and control devices” under “PIN rules and master PIN” (currently: {buttons}) – dashboard buttons and the push button then keep working without a PIN, or
- use the card “Hauswacht Alarm”: whoever is linked to a user with their Home Assistant account switches there without a PIN.

Scheduled profiles and presence automation are not affected.

users_master_pin_only.title: Hauswacht: users without an own PIN
users_master_pin_only.description:
These Hauswacht users have **no own PIN**: **{people}**. At the panel (and with Alexa) they switch with the **master PIN** – the logbook then shows “Master-PIN”, not who it was.

If this is intended, you can ignore this notice. Otherwise:
- give them an own PIN on the settings page (sidebar “Hauswacht”) in the tab “People and control devices”, or
- use the card “Hauswacht Alarm”: whoever is linked to a user with their Home Assistant account switches there without a PIN and under their own name.

Dashboard buttons despite PIN: currently {buttons}.

code_entities.title: Hauswacht: PINs from the keypad end up in the history

confirm.title: Disable the code entity?
confirm.description:
Zigbee2MQTT creates its own entity for the code typed at the keypad. Home Assistant stores it in the history – i.e. every PIN in plain text, also in backups. Hauswacht reads the keypad directly and does not need it.

After you confirm, these entities will be disabled (like Settings → Entities → Disable):

{entities}

You can enable them again there at any time – Hauswacht will not ask again. Home Assistant deletes entries already stored with the normal history purge (default: 10 days), at once with the action "Recorder: Purge entities".
